text: "Maa's Place Senior Center" (eyebrow: "Programs · MAA's Inspiration")

label: Top banner: welcome text
text: A warm, welcoming place where seniors in Dallas–Fort Worth gather for activities, homestyle snacks, chai and companionship, carried forward in the spirit of Maa, whose greatest joy was feeding others.

label: Top banner: quick facts
text: "Mon–Fri 10am–2pm" · "Sat 9:30am–noon" · "Ages 55+" · "214-517-1938" · "2700 Old Denton Rd, Suite 102, Carrollton, TX 75006"; buttons "Plan a Visit" + "Volunteer"

label: What we do
text: Every activity is chosen to keep seniors active in body and mind, learning something new, and enjoying time together.

label: What we do: Physical
text: Yoga, Walking, Tai chi, Musical chairs, Ball in basket, Planting

label: What we do: Mental
text: Yoga, Word search, Crafts

label: What we do: Educational
text: Health insurance help, Phone use, Puzzle games, Beads

label: What we do: Fun & Entertainment
text: Board games, Bingo, Karaoke, Crafts, Beads & jewelry

label: Snacks & chai
text: Homestyle favorites like mini samosas, dhokra, pakora, chaat, vada, nan khatai, fruit salad, banana bread, fresh cookies, and chai.

label: How to visit: step 1
text: Come say hello – Drop in during open hours, call 214-517-1938, or email aslam@maasinspiration.org to schedule a tour.

label: How to visit: step 2
text: Enroll – Complete the short form below; family members can fill it out on a senior's behalf.

label: How to visit: step 3
text: Sign the waiver – Sign our participation waiver and optional photo/video consent on your first visit.

label: Who can come, cost & rides
text: Who can attend: Adults 55 and up · Cost: Free · Transportation: not provided

label: Sign-up form questions
text: Senior's full name*, Date of birth, Phone*, Email (optional), Home address/city & ZIP, Preferred language (English/Urdu-Hindi/Gujarati/Other), Days you plan to attend, Activities of interest, Emergency contact name & relationship*, Emergency contact phone*, Dietary needs/food allergies, Mobility or health needs (optional), Photo/video consent, How did you hear about us?, Agree to waiver*

text: A planned, welcoming recreation program where children and adults with sensory, developmental and special needs, and their families, can learn, play and belong.

label: Our mission
text: Every person deserves a place where they are understood, included and helped to grow. A free recreation program, Blooming Star Village carries Maa's spirit of unconditional care to neurodiverse individuals and the families who love them, offering a calm, supportive community so no family has to find its way alone.

label: What we value
text: Belonging ("differences are welcomed, not just accommodated") · Family support ("parents, siblings and caregivers") · Growth ("skills and confidence at their own pace")

label: Who we serve
text: planned for individuals with sensory processing differences, autism, developmental delays and other special needs, together with their families, across Dallas–Fort Worth.
